purpose: Controlled synthetic shared-white-background robustness,not real data or hidden-feature validation
noise: One Gaussian white context vector per generating seed,scaled by noise_level*true oscillatory mixture RMS sqrt((a*a+b*b)/2),shared across all9phase/pure/background cells;level0 is the same vector scaled0
future_truth: Clean additive sinusoids+offset;white future noise has conditional mean0 and is not realized or copied from context
normalization: All condition errors use SAME per-bundle theoretical clean mixture variance(a*a+b*b)/2 across noise,pure,mixed,and background conditions
composition: ACTUAL native f(A+background)+f(B+background)-f(background);background includes offset and shared context epsilon. This cancels shared-noise double counting and affine forecast intercepts. Known input decomposition remains oracle information.
primary_pass: Positive mean>=0.05 common-clean-mixture-variance MSE,bootstrap95%lowerCI>0,global fixed Holm4 p<0.05

inference.test: two-sided paired-seed signflip plus-one,symmetry/exchangeability assumption;bootstrap predictions fixed

selection: Frozen before native inference;MSE claims always defined,all4retained;no adaptive controls or feature/tangent expansion
